title: A/P Summary and Detail Totals differ by what a Past due filter drops
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: You owe two vendors known amounts, and you compare the Summary and Detail totals with a Past due filter set.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • {Vendor-A} has a bill of $1,000.00 that is not yet due, a bill of $400.00 45 days past due, a bill of $300.00 15 days past due and an unused vendor credit of $150.00; {Vendor-B} has a bill of $500.00 45 days past due and a bill of $250.00 100 days past due. Nothing else is open for the two on today's date.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-24 Filtered One and {Vendor-B} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-24 Filtered Two.
  • Starting screen: A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with {Vendor-A} and {Vendor-B} ticked in the Vendor filter.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Past due filter, tick "31-60 days".
  2. Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) from the Reports menu in a second browser tab.
  3. In the Vendor filter, tick {Vendor-A}.
  4. Tick {Vendor-B}.
  5. In the Past due filter, tick "31-60 days".
  6. Click the chevron button in the table's top-left header cell (Expand all).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: both vendors stay listed (each has an amount 31 to 60 days past due) with their whole balance: {Vendor-A}'s Total $1,550.00 (1,000.00 + 400.00 + 300.00 − 150.00, the not-yet-due amount and the vendor credit included) and {Vendor-B}'s $750.00 (500.00 + 250.00); the Totals row's Total reads $2,300.00.
  • Step 2: A/P Detail opens on today's date with no vendor ticked and Past due on Any.
  • Step 3: {Vendor-A} is ticked.
  • Step 4: both are ticked.
  • Step 5: the chip reads "Past due: 31-60 days" and the report reloads with every group collapsed.
  • Step 6: the rows are {Vendor-A}'s $400.00 bill, {Vendor-B}'s $500.00 bill and {Vendor-A}'s $150.00 vendor credit (every credit is kept); the Totals row's Open Balance reads $750.00 (400.00 + 500.00 − 150.00). It is $1,550.00 less than A/P Summary's $2,300.00 in step 1, exactly what the Detail report leaves out: {Vendor-A}'s $1,000.00 not yet due and $300.00 15 days past due, and {Vendor-B}'s $250.00 100 days past due.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R18a: “For the same as-of date, customer or vendor and Location, with Past due on Any, A/R Summary's Totals equal A/R Detail's Open Balance Totals bucket by bucket, and A/P Summary's equal A/P Detail's. The Detail reports' Amount column holds original amounts and is not compared. With a Past due filter they can differ: a Summary keeps the whole row of a customer or vendor that qualifies (Current and credits included), while a Detail report lists only the invoices or bills that qualify, plus every credit.”
  • S5-R16: “With ranges ticked, A/R Detail, A/R Collection, A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices keep only the invoices and bills whose days past due on the as-of date fall in a ticked range, and always keep credit memos, deposits and vendor credits.”
  • S5-R17: “With ranges ticked, A/R Summary and A/P Summary list only the customers or vendors with some open invoice or bill amount in a ticked range; their rows show their full balances in every bucket.”
  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”
